subject.title: fix(qqbot): require own account credential entries

question: Should QQBot treat prototype-inherited account and credential properties as unsupported configuration and merge this fail-closed normalization?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes behavior for a small class of programmatic configurations; tests and proof establish the implementation, but only maintainers can accept the compatibility and configuration-boundary policy.

options.title: Accept own-property-only configuration
options.body: Merge with the explicit contract that QQBot reads only own configuration properties, preventing inherited credential and identity values from becoming runtime state.

options.title: Preserve inherited programmatic values
options.body: Do not merge this behavior change unless a compatible design can prevent unsafe cleanup while retaining prototype-based account resolution.

recommendation.title: Accept own-property-only configuration
recommendation.body: Merge with the explicit contract that QQBot reads only own configuration properties, preventing inherited credential and identity values from becoming runtime state.
